intro: Section 23.13 covers mentalization-based treatment (MBT): what mentalizing is, the aims of MBT, its techniques and alliance building (Table 23-17), and its indications and contraindications. A dashed box adds a 2023 trial on how long MBT should last.
objectives: Define mentalizing and the aims of MBT.
Describe MBT techniques and how the alliance is built (Table 23-17).
State the indications and contraindications of MBT.
